name: intraday-equities-action-05m
notes: Controlled 5-minute action/label document. Identical to its siblings except name, these notes, window.label_lead, and event-grid.period_ms.

universe.notes: The only market and science knob file. Add a candidate by editing this file plus the source configs; run documents do not restate names.

alpaca.notes: Split-adjusted historical SIP tape (source alpaca-sip-split, ADR-0063): AAPL's 2020 4-for-1, WMT's 2024 3-for-1 and the XLE/XLK 2-for-1s of December 2025 are all removed by the vendor, so no change of unit reads as a price move. start_ms is the study's start date, 2018-01-01 (ADR-0066) - it precedes the earliest bar any fold reads by 2y4m, and it puts XLF's 2016-09-19 XLRE spin-off, the one corporate action the vendor does NOT adjust, outside the readable window. Prices here are NOT the as-traded scale and are not comparable with any number recorded before 2026-09-03. Run from the child root.

session.notes: Research uses regular-session rows; the store still keeps every vendor minute.

window.notes: Elapsed-minute log-return windows. Horizon is this document's only modelling difference besides the grid.

grid.notes: Action cadence. First pass equals the label horizon; decoupling needs a new document.

tradable.notes: Allow-list is $universe.tradable. Reference names stay on the tape for features and never land here.

train_rows.notes: Fit stops at the chronological cut; the lockbox is never here.

val_rows.notes: Selection window after the embargo, before the lockbox.

qhat.notes: Fixed ridge baseline so cadence is chosen before model search.

select.notes: One name among the five tradable names; paper fills come later.

splits.notes: Chronological cuts with a one-day embargo. The latest six months are the lockbox (test); action-window selection and HPO stop at val_end.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd. One experiment so cadence and HPO runs compare in one UI. Params are the declared document; metrics are the final pass. Trials do not reach this sink.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity — where metrics land is not what the run computes.
